name: Find Love EX ~Mind Blowing~
original_name: Find Love EX ～マインドブローイング～
source:
Main character is a private detective in Tokyo. One day he gets a request from the hospital to find the missing nurse Ai. Now the number of missing women has increased. One of the accidentally found girls in semi-naked state told about being kidnapped by a stalker. As the investigation proceeds, the existence of a huge criminal organization becomes evident.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
